query:
SELECT 
  empresaSlug,
  COUNT(*) as dias,
  SUM(CAST(cat1 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat2 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat3 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + 
      CAST(cat4 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat5 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat6 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + 
      CAST(cat7 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat8 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) + CAST(cat9 AS DECIMAL(12,2))) as total_geral
FROM faturamentos
WHERE data >= '2026-05-01' AND data <= '2026-05-09'
GROUP BY empresaSlug
ORDER BY empresaSlug;
